notes.title: “Let’s Seduce the Heroine!” Store Page Up!
notes.content:
Let’s Seduce the Heroine now has a Steam store page up!  [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/872450/Lets_Seduce_the_Heroine/]Wishlist it here![/url]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/872450/Lets_Seduce_the_Heroine/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26932360/6fd70ff4b30c4037bc8527b42ccd37fc5cac8156.png[/img]
[/url]
Let’s Seduce the Heroine is about a girl who is reincarnated into the villainess of an otome game. In order to avoid her scripted demise, she realizes she has to seduce the heroine! It’s a yuri only story where you must survive as the “evil queen” in an otome game.  

The game will be released later this year and i'm very excited about it!

You can wishlist the game on Steam for an email when it’s released, or follow my developer account here: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/razzartvisual]https://store.steampowered.com/developer/razzartvisual
[/url]

notes.title: Check out Mizuchi on Steam!
notes.content:
My good friend at Aikasa Collective has just released Mizuchi!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1121300/Mizuchi/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26932360/facb0ceee746a6bd04b56c32113395f17bebda6f.png[/img]
[/url]
It's a yuri visual novel with hot snake girls and asian folklore! The founder of the studio (as well as writer of the game) was the co-writer of my first game, Starlight Vega, and has been a good friend of mine for many years now. I would love if you would check out her game and consider supporting her release! 


[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1121300/Mizuchi/]Mizuchi Steam Store[/url]

It's on a special 33% launch discount this week on Steam!

notes.title: (18+ Yuri Eroge) "Bloom" Store Page up!
notes.content:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/892740/Bloom/][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32938425/8e65aa0e82d0f5e8d5d63348607f79e6d029e1f6.jpg[/img][/url]

Bloom is an 18+ yuri eroge that explores a mismatched relationship between two women. It’s far more adult oriented than my previous titles, and features explicit uncensored yuri scenes, which brings me to my next bit of news:

Thanks to Valve’s recent changes of allowing adult only content, Bloom will be released 100% uncensored on Steam, with no adult patch needed.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/892740/Bloom/

You can wishlist the game on Steam for an email when it’s released, or follow my developer account here: https://store.steampowered.com/developer/razzartvisual
